overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Kaarina 6 Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna - Black offers a luxurious retreat right in your backyard, designed to accommodate up to six people comfortably. Crafted with a durable all-weather exterior and a beautiful Canadian Red Cedar interior, this sauna provides a serene environment for relaxation and wellness, promoting muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. The 8.0 kW stove with built-in controls ensures efficient heating, while the interior galaxy star color therapy lighting and Bluetooth-enabled sound system enhance your spa-like experience. Ideal for outdoor installation, this sauna is perfect for transforming your patio or garden into a personal wellness sanctuary.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs all-weather exterior outdoor traditional steam sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating traditional sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Barn Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.
Golden Designs traditional saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
